comment: PiForge tenant quota policy. 'default' is what every account gets; 'tenants' overrides one account by user id or by email. A field an override leaves out is inherited from the default; an explicit 0 means unlimited. Mounted read-only into the control plane at /etc/piforge/tenant-limits.json (PIFORGE_TENANT_LIMITS_FILE). The deployment-wide flags -sandbox-cpus/-sandbox-memory/-sandbox-pids are the fallback when this file is absent. pids is 512 as of 2026-11-01 (third adversarial acceptance): the isolated sandbox image measures 216 of 256 pids *idle*, so 256 left ~40 forks of headroom and one line of shell (`for i in $(seq 80); do sleep 600 & done`) wedged it. 512 leaves ~296 slots — a wedge now needs a deliberate storm rather than a typo, and the platform's watchdog detects and repairs it in ~11 s instead of 76 s (internal/httpapi/sandbox_watch.go: 5 s interval, one missed probe confirmed 1.5 s later). The limit is a saturation guard, not the wedge fix: a storm fills every limit measured (64..1024), which is why detection and repair exist at all. Measured with scripts/measure-pids.ps1: a complete runtime does not come up at 64 (one node service fails) and does at 128.
